retrievalProfile.description: A high-key studio portrait with a clean white background and stacked sans-serif typography in the upper-left quadrant.
excludeWhen: dark or moody lighting is required
maximalist or cluttered backgrounds are requested
serif or script typography is preferred

recipe.visualDefinition: A bright, clean composition featuring a female subject positioned on the right side of the frame, looking away from the camera. The left side is dominated by negative white space containing two lines of large, clean sans-serif text. The lighting is soft and even, typical of early 2000s commercial photography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned off-center to create a balanced asymmetrical layout
Typography aligned to the left margin of the negative space
Color palette of the text echoing the warm tones of the subject's skin and hair
High-key lighting blending the background into a pure white void
coreInvariants: Subject looking away from the lens
Stacked text in the upper-left corner

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right 60% of the frame, cropped at the mid-thigh.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the primary line of text in the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold top text, moves down to the second line, then follows the subject's gaze and body line toward the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space on the left side provides breathing room for the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure white background for a clean, commercial feel.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black for secondary text to ensure legibility.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Dusty rose or muted peach for the primary text to match skin tones.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, low to moderate saturation for a soft, feminine look.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or high-contrast primary colors

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Weight contrast within the same typeface family or similar geometric skeletons.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic geometric proportions and sharp terminals.
Modern, clean, and highly legible with a pop aesthetic.
Perfectly circular counters and tight spacing.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key studio photograph of a woman in early 2000s fashion (low-rise jeans, crop top) against a pure white background. Position her on the right side of the frame, looking away from the camera.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of left-aligned, uppercase geometric sans-serif text in the top-left corner. The top line should be bold and in a muted rose color; the second line should be thinner and in black.

verificationChecks: Is the text left-aligned in the upper-left quadrant?
Is the subject positioned on the right side?
Are the fonts clean, uppercase sans-serifs?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of the accent color
mustRedesign: Any background elements other than pure white
postGenerationChecks: Check for pure white background without shadows
Ensure subject is properly cropped and positioned
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key studio portrait + Right-aligned subject + Top-left stacked geometric sans-serif text = Early 2000s Pop Aesthetic.
